text:
Maya (PM): quick sync — acme wants a soft-burst window that can exceed reserved pool for short spikes, but they need predictable billing and rollback if it hits their budget. Thoughts?

Ajay (Eng): is this a new quota type or just a policy on top of existing quotas?

Maya (PM): new policy + quota flag. idea: reserve baseline capacity, allow soft-burst up to X% for Y minutes, charged at higher rate, auto-recover to baseline. need canary/launch criteria.

Clara (SRE): we need clear SLOs: max allowed latency during burst, tail-p99, and preempt timeline. Also obs hooks for when soft-burst is used.

Diego (Sales): customer wants 5x burst for 3 minutes every hour. they'd accept higher price for the burst. They want a UI toggle and audit trail.

Rina (Customer Success): also need an escape hatch: auto-refund or credits if burst causes degraded outputs or timeouts. Ops wants to avoid manual escalations.

Ajay (Eng): implementation sketch: introduce "soft_burst" policy attached to reserved_pool. fields: 
```
soft_burst: {
  enabled: true,
  max_multiplier: 5,
  window_seconds: 180,
  cooldown_seconds: 3600,
  billing_tier: "burst-premium"
}
```
We can enforce with admission controller + metrics guardrails.

Clara (SRE): +1 to admission controller. Need to emit these metrics: reserved_used, soft_burst_used, burst_entries, burst_evictions, burst_latency_p99. Also tag traces with pool_id + tenant_id.

Maya (PM): launch criteria proposal:
- telemetry: all metrics above visible in Console (per-tenant, per-pool)
- billing: accurate per-event billing export for accounting (CSV + API)
- safety: preempt policy that returns to baseline within window if system pressure > threshold
- canary: roll to 5 internal tenants, then 3 pilot customers (including Acme)

Diego (Sales): timeline? Acme is pushing for next quarter pilot. They want an SLA addendum for the pilot.

Ajay (Eng): rough S/W estimate: admission controller + policy surface (2 w), metrics + tagging (1 w), billing export changes (1 w), console flags/UI (2 w), canary infra & runbook (1 w) = ~7 wks across teams (parallel).

Clara (SRE): ops/runbook items:
- automatic rollback criteria: cluster_utilization > 80% for 2m OR burst_evictions > 5 in 10m
- oncall play: page if rollback triggers OR if burst latency_p99 > 500ms for 5m
- dry-run mode to validate metrics without actually charging

Maya (PM): product tradeoffs to call out:
- fairness: allowing soft-burst could starve lower-tier tenants unless preemptive drain is enforced
- complexity: billing + UI adds ops cost for manual disputes
- predictability: customers like Acme want burst certainty; our commitment must be scoped (e.g., limited # of bursts per billing cycle)

Rina (Customer Success): recommend a customer-facing doc template: "Pilot terms: allowed bursts, price per burst unit, dispute window, rollback behavior." We can reuse for other pilots.

Diego (Sales): also ask for contract language: can we offer burst SLA only during committed hours / region? helps capacity planning.

Ajay (Eng): technical decision needed: soft_burst enforcement location. Options:
1) Router-level quick tokens: cheap but coarse-grained per-request accounting.
2) Worker-side admission with token bucket per-tenant: better accuracy, higher overhead.
3) Hybrid: router-level fast check + worker-side authoritative accounting.

Clara (SRE): prefer hybrid. router-level for quick path + metric tag, worker verifies and emits final billing event. reduces impact on p99 path.

Maya (PM): decision: go hybrid for pilot. next: define default pilot limits and customer config knobs. Proposed default: max_multiplier=3, window_seconds=120, cooldown_seconds=3600, burst_quota_per_month=5000 burst-units.

Ajay (Eng): noted. I'll open an RFC for API + schema. Will include migration path for existing reserved_pools.

ops-bot: scheduled: "soft-burst-rfc-draft" assigned to Ajay, due in 7d.

Diego (Sales): can we add a telemetry checkbox for customers: "notify me when my soft-burst > 50% of allowed monthly quota" so they don't get surprised.

Rina (Customer Success): +1. also want a weekly usage digest email for pilot participants.

Maya (PM): action items:
- Ajay: RFC + prototype (7d)
- Clara: define alarm thresholds + runbook doc (10d)
- Diego/Rina: pilot contract + customer comms (7d)
- Eng + Billing: finalize billing event format (CSV + API) (10d)
We'll reconvene after RFC review. :calendar:

Clara (SRE): one more: add a safe-fallback model variant when burst triggers to reduce compute (quantized small model) — reduces cost and keeps latency. Ops to own mapping.

Ajay (Eng): good call. will add model-fallback hook to the policy plan.

Maya (PM): thanks all — filing notes into roadmap epic (dedicated/capacity/soft-burst). If anyone wants to add asks, drop them here. :sparkles:
